# Clan techniques and kekkei genkai

All 25 clans in four tiers: tier 1 at Genin (level 10), tier 2 at Chunin (20), tier 3 at Jonin (32), tier 4 on the road to Hokage (44). The player is clanless (the owner's decision), so these are the kits of clan residents, teammates, rivals and enemies; the player's clan route is each clan's lesser technique, learned at clan friendship 7. Kekkei genkai come only through clan blood.
